reason: We have decided to go into the new country and my trade fair contacts there are thin, so I need a pipeline fast. The free list of 15 companies costs me nothing, and if it looks right, EUR 500 plus paying only for meetings that actually happen is a risk I can carry.
objection: My name is everything in this trade. If some agency spams buyers in my new market, or I get a GDPR letter, I lose more than EUR 3,600. And you are pitching me the same way all the others do on LinkedIn every week.
would_change_my_mind: If the past client you put me in touch with is not in wholesale, or the 15 companies are names I could have found myself, I walk away.
